text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Ruka and {0}, who's helping with
Ruka's part-time work, make their way to a town along
the coast to procure some fish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はルカがバイトしている魚屋の手伝いとして、
海岸近くの街へ魚の仕入れに向かった。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Finally here.
I'm counting on you today, partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
ようやく到着だ。
今日はよろしく頼むよ、
お前さん。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Though we're just picking up the fish and bringing it back,
so there's no need to stress out about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
といっても魚を仕入れて運ぶだけだ。
楽にしてていいよ。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Ruka.
I... take it the news hasn't made it back to Landosol yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
ルカじゃないか。
……そうか、
ランドソルにはまだ伝わってないんだな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You seem pretty dejected.
What's up? Did something happen?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたのさ。
えらく不景気そうじゃないか。
どうかしたのかい？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it to you straight.
I've got absolutely no fish to sell you today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は……
今日は売り物になる魚がないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Not a single one?
text_block_list.orig_text: 一匹も？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Yup. Not a single one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
一匹もだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Fill me in.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……何があったのさ？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
Well... A monster's been rampaging across the coast lately.
None of us can go out to fish.
And it's not just here—it's popping up at the next town over, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが……
昨日からこの辺りの海岸一帯に凶暴な魔物が出て、
漁に出られないんだ。
しかもその魔物、
ウチの町と隣町をまたぐように現れやがる。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Which means we'd be wasting our time if we went there, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことは、
隣町に行っても無駄足か……

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: Aye. It's been pretty grim for us back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り。
俺たちの町もひどい有様だよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Oh. You're from there, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタ、
隣町の……

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text:
It's not just us, either.
Even customers like you are suffering thanks to that thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たち漁師だけじゃない。
アンタたちみたく買いつけに来た人たちも、
ヤツのせいでみんな困ってるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 3
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! We're done for at this rate!
You sure there's no way for us to deal with it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちくしょう！　
このままじゃ商売あがったりだぜ……！
あの魔物を倒す方法はないのかよ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
We tried everything we could! Hell, even you guys gave up hope!
We'd have gotten rid of it already if we could,
so quit it with the stupid questions!
text_block_list.orig_text:
散々試しただろうが！　
隣町のお前らだってお手上げだろ！？
簡単に倒せるなら俺たちだけでやってるよ！
そんなことも分かんねぇのか！？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 3
text_block_list.text:
What'd you just say?!
I don't need some dumbass going off at me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだとこの野郎！　
テメェに言われなくたって百も承知だよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Would you two quit whining?! It's pathetic!
Adults shouldn't be bickering at times like this!
If you want to complain, then go do it elsewhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃあぎゃあうるさいよ、
みっともない！
大の大人がこんな時に喧嘩してどうする！
吠えるだけならよそでやりな！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... We really did everything we could, though.
It just wasn't enough!
Arrows and magic won't work on that thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまない……
俺たちだって出来る限りのことはしたんだ。
でもよ！　
弓矢も魔法も、
なにも効かなくて……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Wait, magic too? That's not good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法も？　
そいつは厄介だね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'm the only one that
can do anything about it. Good grief.
Guess I don't have much of a choice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
となると、
何とか出来そうなのはアタシだけか……
やれやれ……
仕方ないね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me. I'll deal with that thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その魔物、
アタシが片付けるよ。

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 3
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, for real?!
I know you've got a nice sword there,
but aren't you just a fishmonger?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇっ！？　
で、
でも大丈夫なのか？
確かに武器は持ってるけど、
ルカ。
アンタ魚屋なんだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter. As long as that thing goes down, it's fine, right?
One condition, though. Give me a little discount after it's gone, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魚屋だろうが騎士だろうが、
魔物を倒せるなら何だっていいじゃないか。
その代わり、
アタシが魔物を倒せたら、魚はまけてくれるよな？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
G-got it.
It'll be more than a little, at that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わかった。
倒してくれたらいくらでも安くする。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Perfect. Just leave this to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
決まりだね。
アタシに任せな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hm...?
Is this an earthquake? That's pretty rare.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？　
珍しいね、
地震かい？

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 3
text_block_list.text: That's no earthquake. It's—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや違う！　
これは──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Rrrrrrraaaaargghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: It's back! Run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
奴がきたぞぉ！　
みんな逃げろ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Well that's convenient.
Now we don't need to track it down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
早速お出ましか。
探す手間が省けたね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Haha. Figures that you'd be worried about me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
心配してくれるなんて、
お前さんは優しいね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: It's all right, I'm here with you. Don't forget that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着きなって。
アタシがついてるんだから大丈夫さ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I've taken down plenty of monsters like this before.
You just stay back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツくらいの魔物なら、
何度も相手にしてきたから平気だよ。
お前さんは下がってな！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
...You're serious, aren't you? Got it!
Then do me a favor and get its attention! Just for a little bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん！　
……
本気だね。
よし分かった！
少しの間でいい。
ヤツの注意を引いといておくれ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?!
Didn't think that kid had the guts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ねぇっ！　
あの兄ちゃん、
ボケッとしてるかと思ったら度胸あんだな！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: He's buying time, but what's Ruka up to?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
時間稼ぎみてぇだが、
ルカは何やってんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Get outta there, kid! Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げろ兄ちゃん！！　
ああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Now!
text_block_list.orig_text: 今だっ──！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hah! First Strike: Reticence!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──はぁっ！　
一の太刀、
雫薙ぎ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GREEOOOUGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 3
text_block_list.text: Oh my god! That was amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおぉっ！　
すげぇぇぇぇっ！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: It's not over yet, though!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
まだだ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text:
How's it still moving?!
Ruka! Get out of there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツまだ動けるのか！　
ルカ！　
逃げろ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting it to survive that!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一撃で仕留めきれなかったとはね……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Did I not imbue enough chi into that strike?!
Either way, I can't back down now!
It's up to me to protect them! To protect [i]him![/i]
text_block_list.orig_text:
気の練り込みが足りなかった……！？
……だとしても、
退くわけにはいかないね！
みんなもあの子も、
アタシが守らなきゃいけないんだ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
W-what the?! What's going on?!
I can feel my power overflowing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！？　
なんだい、
こいつは……！　
力が溢れてくる……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The flow of my chi feels a lot smoother, too! I can do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気の流れが桁違いに良くなった！　
これならいける！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If it's a fight you want, I'm happy to oblige!
Second Strike: Autumn Deluge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに欲しけりゃもういっちょくらいな！
二の太刀、
露時雨っ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GREEOOOUGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 1
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Incredible! She actually pulled it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおおおっ！　
すげぇっ！　
ホントにやりやがった……！

text_block_list.name: Fisherman 2
text_block_list.text: The ocean's safe again now! Thank you so much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでまた海に出られる……！　
ありがてぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... 
I was a bit worried for a minute there, but it all worked out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
一時はどうなるかと思ったけど、
なんとかなったね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You put in some good work, yourself.
You've got an impressive pair of legs on you. But I have to know...
Were you responsible for what happened just then?
choice_data_list: I didn't do anything of note.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん。
お疲れ様。
いい逃げっぷりだったよ。
ところで
さっきのは、
お前さんが何かやったのかい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I knew it.
Now that's an incredible technique you've got there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりそうかい。
すごい技だね！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
No need to be humble.
You sure caught me off guard with it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
謙遜しなくていいさ。
あんな技を持ってるなんて驚いたよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I'd be in a pretty bad state if it weren't for you, you know.
And for that, you get some praise! Attaboy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんがいなかったら、
今頃こうして無事じゃいられなかったよ。
良くやってくれたね！　
よしよし！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oops. Sorry about that.
Seeing you put that much effort in made me want to hug you.
Really, though—thanks. You saved me big time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっとすまない。
お前さんの頑張りを見ると、
つい抱き締めたくなっちまうよ。
でも
今日は、本当に助かった。
ありがとね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Mind lending me a hand again if I need it? I'd really appreciate it.
For now, though, let's go catch ourselves some fish!
We can stock up after that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今後も手が足りない時は、
お前さんの力を貸しておくれ。
よーし！　
それじゃあアタシたちも魚を捕りに行くよ！
仕入れはその後だ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Following the day's events, Ruka came to see
{0} as a reliable partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──この日から{0}はルカにとって、
頼りに出来る相手となった。
